essential

The

thick
cuts
of
red
beef
being
sliced

a
board
,
and
the
bottom-left
transforms
these
into
pan-seared
steaks
in
a
skillet
with
butter
and
herbs
on
a
gas
stovetop
.
Notably
,
the
bottom-right
mirrors
the
opening
step
as
the
skillet
is
scrubbed
clean
,
bringing
the
cycle
full
circle
.
This
bookending
of
hygiene
at
both
ends
highlights
